// diagnostic E0917

Jet.RecursiveInlineAlways

`#Inline(Always) fn` calls itself, directly or through other marked functions — inlining a recursive call has no fixed expansion

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` calls itself, directly or through other marked functions — inlining a recursive call has no fixed expansion

Why

`#Inline(Always)` guarantees every direct call is inlined on every tier, and a body that calls itself would be copied without end. Sema refuses each mark that can't keep the guarantee: a call of itself or a cycle of marked calls (Jet.RecursiveInlineAlways), a use as a value (Jet.InlineAlwaysAddressTaken), a body over the size ceiling (Jet.InlineAlwaysTooLarge), `#Scrub` (Jet.InlineAlwaysScrub), a read of `context.trace` (Jet.InlineAlwaysReadsTrace) and a foreign body (Jet.InlineAlwaysForeign)

Fix

Remove the recursion or the cycle, or relax the marker on one function of it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.RecursiveInlineAlways: Tests/UI/inline_always_cycle.stderr.

Error: Jet.RecursiveInlineAlways: `pong` calls `ping`, whose calls lead back to `pong`, so `#Inline(Always)` cannot expand them
  --> Tests/UI/inline_always_cycle.jet:5:66
    |
  5 | #Inline(Always) pong: fn(n: Int) -> Int { if n <= 0 -> 1 else -> ping(n - 1) }
    |                                                                  ^^^^
 Why: Each inlined copy would hold the next one, so expanding the cycle would never end. `#Inline(Always)` guarantees that every direct call is inlined on every tier, or the program is refused: sema refuses a function that calls itself or closes a cycle of marked calls (Jet.RecursiveInlineAlways), one used as a value (Jet.InlineAlwaysAddressTaken), one over the size ceiling (Jet.InlineAlwaysTooLarge), a `#Scrub` routine (Jet.InlineAlwaysScrub), one that reads `context.trace` (Jet.InlineAlwaysReadsTrace) and one with a foreign body (Jet.InlineAlwaysForeign).
 Fix: Drop `#Inline(Always)` from one function of the cycle (use `#Inline` as a hint), or break the cycle.
